MEET CHAINSAF

A small change.
A better hauling routine.

Your chains belong with your trailer. ChainSaf combines on-trailer storage with dedicated tie-down points, so your gear is there when it’s time to secure a load.

01

Keep your gear together

Store chains, binders, or ratchet straps on the trailer instead of carrying them from the truck.

02

Keep the deck clear

A flush-mounted design lets equipment pass over the boxes during loading.

03

Put excess chain away

Store unused chain in the box while your load is secured.

FROM LOADING TO UNLOADING

Ready when you are.

One place for the gear.
A simpler routine on the deck.

01

Load your trailer

The boxes sit flush with the deck, keeping the loading surface clear.

02

Pull out your gear

Your chains and binders are stored where you need them. Use the dedicated pull points to secure your load.

03

Stow it when you’re done

After unloading, put your securement gear back in the boxes for the next trip.

A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Know before
you haul.

Still have a question?
Call Tony: (512) 247-8795

Does it work with ratchet straps?+

Yes. ChainSaf’s current product information says the system is designed for both chains and ratchet straps. Confirm the box size and appropriate rating for your setup with Tony.

Can I install it myself?+

Most uses require welding the box to the trailer frame. The company notes that some light-duty applications may allow bolting. Ask for the installation requirements for your exact trailer before making changes.

How much weight can it handle?+

Ask ChainSaf for the rated working load limit for the exact product and mounting method. The strength-test figure on the current website is not a trailer payload or a published working load limit.

What maintenance is needed?+

The company recommends rinsing the boxes when sand or gravel builds up. Follow the product’s care and inspection instructions.

How do I buy ChainSaf?+

Contact Tony to confirm sizes, rated limits, current pricing, and installation requirements, then arrange your order directly with the business.
